title: Rasmalai Recipe in 30 minutes | Soft and Spongy Rasmalai Recipe
description:
An easy way to make a delicious Rasmalai recipe at home within 30 minutes.

Do try it at home and share your feedback! 

Ingredients

For Paneer:
Full-Fat Milk (1 Litre)
Vinegar/Lemon Juice (2 tbsp) mixed in 2 tbsp water 
All-Purpose Flour 1/2 tsp
Cardamom Powder 1/4 tsp
A Pinch of Baking Powder 

For Sugar Syrup:
Sugar (1 Cup)
Water (6 Cups)

For Rabri:
Milk (1 Litre)
Sugar (1/2 Cup)
Green Cardamom (4)
